question: Are low-value assets (canonical rankDerivedValue < ~3000) mis-valued? Value dynamics and replacement cost, not trades.

labels.laneA: SENSITIVITY REPLAY - today's methodology on each day's archived raw payload plus the source CSVs as committed at that moment; no dataset state supplied, so freshness weighting is off for every board. NOT observed history.
labels.laneB: Vendor values read directly from the archives (no rebuild).
labels.missingIsNotZero: Assets absent from / unpriced on the end board are reported as shares, never valued at 0; log ratios are over assets priced on both boards.

caveats: Lane A boards are SENSITIVITY REPLAYS (today's code on past inputs), not observed history.

Today's code votes KTC only through the ktcCrowdSfTep / ktcTradesSfTep CSVs, which the window's early CSV trees do not contain: replay boards before the split carry NO KTC vote. The constant panel therefore excludes KTC on every board.
Freshness weighting is off on every replay board (no dataset state is reconstructed).
Start dates are weekly, so pairs overlap: per-band n counts asset-start pairs, not independent observations (nDistinctAssets is reported beside n).
The '<500' canonical band is dominated by floor-valued rows (single-source, deep tail); its large mean log ratios are floor exits, not market moves.
Vendor lanes band each asset on the VENDOR's own 0-9999 value, not the canonical value; positions/rookie flags are borrowed from the nearest canonical board by name.
KTC publishes its top ~500 rows only; 'absent' in the KTC lane is falling off KTC's board, not KTC pricing the player at zero. IDPTC content changes on few days.
Lane C: 412 dynasty leagues, mostly superflex, few start IDP, so IDP replacement evidence is thin. Bids are % of each league's own waiver budget.
Lane D quantile map is rank-preserving: it tests ORDER (is a band ranked above its ROS usefulness), not curve SHAPE; rosValue is a rank score, not points.

constantPanel.note: Sources voting on EVERY rebuilt board; the rest (sources the window's early CSV trees do not contain, incl. the KTC Crowd/Trades split) are disabled via source_overrides so value change is not a panel-composition artifact. The as-published panel is reported beside it.

laneA_canonicalAging_laggedBanding.note: Band assigned by value 7 days BEFORE the start (instrument against regression-to-the-mean from banding on a noisy start value); outcome is still log(V_end / V_start).

laneC_waiverReplacementCost.label: Values are from the nearest REBUILT board (sensitivity replay: today's code on that day's archived inputs), not observed history.

laneD_rosCurveCheck.label: Canonical values from REBUILT boards (sensitivity replay). ROS is the seasonal lane (redraft usefulness), diagnostic only. Players without a ROS row are reported as missing, never as zero usefulness. 'RosImplied' = canonical value at the same order statistic as the player's rosValue among joined players (quantile map).
